<thought>To identify the fragments that can be joined, I need more structural clues beyond the carbon shifts. The HSQC spectrum will correlate the carbon signals with attached protons, helping to distinguish which aromatic carbons are protonated versus quaternary, and to locate the methoxy group. This will allow me to propose reasonable fragment SMILES strings.</thought>
